# Sealbreaker fragment

Type: Material | Internal ID: DvergrKeyFragment | Source: Infested Mines | Usage: Crafting | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Sealbreaker fragments are resources obtained from Infested Mines in the Mistlands that are used to build the Sealbreaker.
Nine total fragments are required to build one Sealbreaker.

## Availability

• Infested Mines in Mistlands. Found in blue-lit glass displays throughout the mines.

### Crafting

• Sealbreaker

Categorias: Materials
